head: claude/sweep-appa-sec3-translatedfourier-printed-c34d
title: Prove Printed.padicTamagawaFourier_translatedScaledIntegers_false (AppA Sec3)
body:
Proves the refutation `Printed.padicTamagawaFourier_translatedScaledIntegers_false` (Example A.3.1.6, (A.3.1.5), p. 557) in `RiemannMasullo/AppA_AlgebraicNT/Sec3_TranslatedFourier_Printed.lean`. Only the proof is filled in; no statement changes, no new declarations.

Closes #5770

**Counterexample** (as in the docstring): `p = 3`, `n = 0`, `a = 1/3`, `x = 0`, first conjunct.
- Left side: at frequency 0 the character is 1 (`padicStandardCharacter_div_pow` with numerator 0), so the transform is the mass of `1/3 + ℤ₃`, which by translation invariance of the additive Haar measure `padicTamagawaMeasure 3` equals the mass of `ℤ₃`, i.e. 1.
- Right side: `1 * transform f₀ (-1/3)`. Since `(z⁻¹ : ℂ) = conj z` on the circle, the transform with the inverted character is the complex conjugate of `tamagawaFourier μ (padicStandardCharacter 3) f₀ (-1/3)`, which by `padicTamagawaFourier_scaledIntegers 3 0` is the indicator of `ℤ₃` at `-1/3`, i.e. 0 because `‖-1/3‖₃ = 3`.
- So `1 = 0`.

No helper lemmas; one proof of ~45 lines, elaborates in a few seconds.

**Checks run**
- `lake build RiemannMasullo.AppA_AlgebraicNT.Sec3_TranslatedFourier_Printed`: ok.
- `#print axioms RiemannMasullo.Printed.padicTamagawaFourier_translatedScaledIntegers_false`: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
- `lake build` (full): ok, 24 min.
- `scripts/lint.sh`: `lint: ok`.
- Statement hashes of the module (`lake env lean --run scripts/Signatures.lean RiemannMasullo.AppA_AlgebraicNT.Sec3_TranslatedFourier_Printed` before and after, then `scripts/signatures.sh --compare`): identical, no changes.
